open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intro h
  induction h <;> simp_all [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, extractOldExprVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.Subset]
  case quant => intro x hx; simp_all [List.mem_append]
  case app => intro x hx; simp_all [List.mem_append, IsOldPred, IsFvar]
  case ite => intro x hx; simp_all [List.mem_append]
  case eq => intro x hx; simp_all [List.mem_append]
